capabilities: open the current note's URL built from its permalink property
configure the frontmatter property name used for permalinks
set live and development site base URLs
slugify the note title in kebab case when no permalink is set
trigger opening via command palette or hotkeys
disambiguation: It does not publish or build a site; it only opens the existing URL for the current note.
extras: The README shows example values for the base URL settings (e.g. a Jekyll development site) but is otherwise brief.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open the published web page for a note based on its permalink frontmatter property.
summary: Opens the live URL of the current note by combining a permalink or slug property with a configurable base URL, aimed at static site generators.
